speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with hand tremors and recent memory issues; can you tell me if these symptoms started suddenly or developed gradually over time?

Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your speech, balance, or movement patterns like stiffness or shuffling gait?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early cognitive involvement or Parkinson's Dementia.

I need to clarify if the tremor is more prominent at rest or when using his hands, and whether he experiences stiffness in his limbs. Also, has he noticed any changes in his sense of smell or any episodes of unexplained falls?
